title: Everything crawls because Windows Update is mid-download

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
The laptop is nearly unusable today. Fan going constantly, everything takes an
age. It started after I turned it on this morning - it had been off since
Friday.

There is a spinning thing in the system tray about updates, if that matters.
Disk is only half full.

Mel

triage.subcategory: update in progress consuming the disk

must_include.what: An update mid-download consumes the disk and makes everything crawl; let it finish

must_not_include.what: Sends her to clear disk space she has already said is half free
Raises a hardware refresh for a four-day-old symptom

characteristics: Explains the cause rather than listing the whole runbook
Says what to expect: it settles when the update finishes

rationale: Step 4 of the runbook, and she has already ruled out steps 1 and 2 herself - the machine was off all weekend so it has just restarted, and the disk is half empty. Annoying but she can work, so P3. The case exists because the runbook's first two steps are the ones a model reaches for by default, and here they are both already answered in the ticket.
